name: Clarity AI - Image Upscaling
description: Creative diffusion-based image upscaling that adds detail.

paragraphs: Clarity AI is a creative image upscaler that increases resolution and adds realistic, natural detail using a Stable Diffusion Tile ControlNet. It synthesizes fine detail instead of just interpolating pixels, so edges stay sharp and textures look convincing at higher resolution. Real-ESRGAN handles the initial upscale, then tiled ControlNet passes reconstruct convincing texture across the full image.

Use it for enlarging small or low-resolution images, restoring lost detail in old pictures, sharpening blurry shots, and preparing photos, artwork, and product images for large prints. Advanced options tune detail strength, guidance, HDR effect, and ControlNet influence so you can dial in exactly how much enhancement to apply.
Built by Upsampler, a suite of AI image and video tools.
